title: plantago major var. minor
intro: Plantago major var. minor, commonly known as little plantain or narrow leaf plantain, is a type of plant that belongs to the Plantaginaceae family. It is a perennial herb with narrow, lance-shaped leaves that grows in many parts of the world. This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce inflammation, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Plantago major var. minor are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and soothing properties.
